start:
@startuml
actor user
participant app
participant db
user -> app: login
app -> db: query
db --> app: rows
app --> user: ok
@enduml

after.text:
@startuml
actor user
participant app
participant db
user -> app: login
activate db
app -> db: query
db --> app: rows
deactivate db
app --> user: ok
@enduml

uml-pg-tool-status.text: Added activation for "db". Drag its top or bottom edge to change when it starts and stops.

uml-pg-class-selection.text: Select one class to edit its name or members.

after.properties:
- region "Activation — db":
  - heading "Activation — db" [level=2]
  - button "✕ Delete"
  - paragraph: "Shows when \"db\" is active. Move where it starts and stops:"
  - group "Starts":
    - text: Starts
    - button "Starts — move earlier": Earlier
    - button "Starts — move later": Later
  - group "Stops":
    - text: Stops
    - button "Stops — move earlier": Earlier
    - button "Stops — move later": Later
  - group "Move whole bar":
    - text: Move whole bar
    - button "Move whole bar — move earlier": Earlier
    - button "Move whole bar — move later": Later
  - paragraph: "Tip: on the canvas, drag the bar’s top or bottom edge, or press ↑/↓ (Shift+↑/↓ for the end, Alt+↑/↓ to move it). Press Delete to remove."
  - button "Add teaching callout"
